draft_key_information_units.information: Ambu reported Q1 2025/26 revenue of DKK 1,558m, representing 8.6% organic growth (3.2% reported), with EBIT before special items of DKK 164m (10.5% margin, adjusted to 15.2% excluding tariff and FX impacts).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue increased organically by 8.6% (19.5%) to DKK 1,558m (DKK 1,510m), with reported growth of 3.2% (20.4%). EBIT before special items (b.s.i.) was DKK 164m (DKK 243m), with an EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5% (16.1%), negatively impacted by tariff costs and FX headwind; adjusted margin was 15.2%.

draft_key_information_units.information: Endoscopy Solutions grew organically by 14.4%, driven by Respiratory (8.3%) and URO, ENT & GI (21.0%), while Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% due to high comparative baseline.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Endoscopy Solutions increased organically by 14.4% (20.6%). Respiratory posted 8.3% organic growth. URO, ENT, & GI posted 21.0% organic growth. Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% (17.8%), reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue achieved in the same quarter last year.

draft_key_information_units.information: Organic revenue growth was 9.8% in North America and 9.7% in Europe, offset by Rest of World decline of -1.6% due to order fluctuations and high comparable revenue.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue growth was driven by solid organic growth in North America and Europe, respectively posting 9.8% (19.2%) and 9.7% (17.1%). Rest of World declined by -1.6% (28.0%), due to order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from last year.

draft_key_information_units.information: EBIT margin before special items decreased to 10.5% (from 16.1% year‑ago), primarily due to tariff costs and FX headwinds, with an underlying margin of 15.2% reflecting operational leverage.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5% (16.1%), the latter negatively impacted by tariff costs and FX headwind. Adjusting for tariff costs and FX, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2% in the quarter, demonstrating continued operational leverage.

draft_key_information_units.information: Free cash flow before acquisitions was DKK 13m (down from DKK 69m), mainly due to working capital changes, FX headwind and tariff costs; Ambu paid a DKK 90m dividend and acquired DKK 38m of treasury shares.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions totaled DKK 13m (DKK 69m). This was mainly negatively impacted by a change in net working capital, which remained elevated to mitigate global geopolitical uncertainties and support growth. FCF was also impacted by both FX headwind and tariff costs. Ambu paid out DKK 90m in dividend in Q1, corresponding to DKK 0.41 per share. In addition, DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares in Q1 as part of Ambu’s share buyback program.

draft_key_information_units.information: Ambu launched the portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope and announced extension of the Recircle Program to include recycling of SureSight video laryngoscope blades in 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Introduction of Ambu’s portable video laryngoscope solution, SureSight Mobile, expanding Ambu’s video laryngoscope portfolio and Respiratory offering. Extension of the Ambu Recircle Program to include the collection and recycling of blades from Ambu’s video laryngoscopy solution, Ambu SureSight Connect, in 2026.

draft_key_information_units.information: Ambu maintained its FY 2025/26 guidance of 10-13% organic revenue growth and 12-14% EBIT margin before special items, indicating higher growth and margins expected in H2.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The 2025/26 financial guidance is maintained. Growth and EBIT margin are still expected to be higher in H2 compared to H1. Organic revenue growth: 10-13%. EBIT margin b.s.i.: 12-14%.

draft_key_information_units.information: Ambu advanced sustainability initiatives, producing the first batch of recycled material from endoscopes and committing to SBTI net‑zero emissions target.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: A key Q1 milestone was the production of the first batch of recycled material derived from collected endoscopes. Ambu has officially made a commitment to the official SBTI net-zero target and is now subsequently preparing for data submission to SBTI.

evaluation.selection_rationale: These eight units capture the material aspects required for a concise financial-report summary: headline revenue, profitability and margin drivers (D1, D4); major segment and regional performance divergences (D2, D3); liquidity and capital return actions (D5); key strategic product and sustainability developments (D6, D8); and unchanged full-year guidance providing forward context (D7). Each unit represents an independently omittable theme supported exclusively by the source report, avoiding boilerplate and non-material details. The selection balances breadth of financial, operational, and strategic information while staying within the recommended granularity (6-10 units).
